answer: Simultaneous sensor attestation. Each identity must answer a challenge in the same short window using readings from its own hardware: ambient light, sound, and motion. A single operator cannot fabricate independent readings for many co-located devices. A timber floor's vibration differs across real placements. A tide-driven hum does the same. An onyx desk's thermal lag gives another location-bound trace. Enforcement: duplicate signatures or identical environmental traces void all linked identities. Per-identity cost: a separate powered sensor node at a distinct location plus maintenance.
